features: Permanent & Reliable Strap: Featuring a strong, built-in tether, this strapped football mouthguard stays securely in place, offering reliable protection all game long.
Elite Comfort & Protection: This football mouthguard features soft cushioned bite pads that absorb impact, reduce shock, and deliver unmatched comfort during games, practices, and training sessions.
Optimized Airflow Design: Designed with an oversized oxygen hole, this mouthpiece boosts airflow to help players stay focused, improve endurance, and perform at their peak.
Universal Fit for All Athletes: Suitable for youth and adult players with or without braces, this football mouthguard ensures a secure, no-slip fit for optimal protection and comfort.
Easy to Clean: Easy to rinse and clean after every use, this mouthguard is built from durable, non-toxic materials to ensure freshness and performance all season.
